note: All strings must be ENGLISH: anything that lands in the .tex passes through a CJK guard that replaces Chinese with 'variable'. Probes are case-insensitive substrings searched in the lowercased body.

mechanism.name: dimensional consistency or non-dimensionalisation
mechanism.note: both sides of a mechanism equation must carry the same units

mechanism.name: limiting case or closed-form check
mechanism.note: a case with a known answer is the cheapest validation

regression.name: influence or leverage diagnostics
regression.note: a few points can decide the coefficients on their own

regression.name: collinearity diagnostics
regression.note: under collinearity individual coefficients are not interpretable

regression.name: heteroskedasticity or normality test
regression.note: intervals and significance both rest on the variance assumption

optimization.name: feasibility and optimality check
optimization.note: whether the solution is feasible and whether it is optimal are two claims

optimization.name: local-optimum risk if the search is non-convex
optimization.note: 'global' alone matches 'global market'; require the optimisation sense

prediction.name: rolling or hold-out validation
prediction.note: time series cannot be validated by random-fold cross-validation alone

prediction.name: stationarity or autocorrelation check
prediction.note: regressing a non-stationary series on another is spurious

prediction.name: residual diagnostics for remaining structure
prediction.note: plain residual diagnostics belong to regression; this check is about structure *left in* them over time

evaluation.name: normalisation direction and scale
evaluation.note: a 'normalised gap' is a regret measure, not indicator normalisation; 'direction of association' is not indicator direction

evaluation.name: weight provenance and sensitivity
evaluation.note: a weighted sum is arithmetic, not a justification of where the weights came from

evaluation.name: agreement between two evaluation methods
evaluation.note: 'the relation stays consistent with theory' is not agreement between two evaluation methods

clustering.name: basis for the number of clusters
clustering.note: the cluster count is a model parameter, not a taste

clustering.name: stability of the partition
clustering.note: a partition that changes with the seed is not a finding

clustering.name: preconditions and distance metric
clustering.note: without standardisation the largest-variance variable dominates

multiobjective.name: coverage and spread of the reported front
multiobjective.note: 'coverage of the literature' is not front coverage

multiobjective.name: a rule for choosing among the front
multiobjective.note: the front itself does not select a design

simulation.name: randomness source and seed
simulation.note: the bare word 'random' appears in any paper that mentions randomness at all; require the seed

simulation.name: replication count and convergence
simulation.note: too few replications make the reported interval fiction

simulation.name: variance reduction or efficiency note
simulation.note: can cut the variance without changing the estimand

network.name: algorithmic complexity
network.note: model complexity (a goodness-of-fit notion) is NOT algorithmic complexity; the probe must say which

network.name: optimality or feasibility certificate
network.note: 'optimal design' means a good design, not a proof of optimality; the probe must say 'optimality'

network.name: scale or runtime test
network.note: a sensitivity analysis is not a scale test; drop the generic word
